name: @carely/shared
description: Shared enums, validation schemas and contracts for Carely

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.esm.json && tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('dist/cjs/package.json', JSON.stringify({type:'commonjs'}))" && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('dist/esm/package.json', JSON.stringify({type:'module'}))"
